b2plus-lazim-ma.title: Mustn't/Shouldn't: Lazim Ma
b2plus-lazim-ma.explanation: To say someone shouldn't do something, ما slots in right before the verb, after لازم stays in place: لازم ما تروح الحين (laazim ma truu7 el-heen, "you shouldn't go now"). لازم itself never takes ما directly -- the negation always attaches to the verb that follows it.
b2plus-lazim-ma.fact: This exact pattern -- a fixed modal word followed by ما plus a verb -- is one of the most common ways Gulf Arabic gives advice or warnings, similar to how English speakers lean on "shouldn't" far more often than a flat "don't."

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Drink, You Shouldn't Go
lessons.titleNative: لازم ما تشرب، لازم ما تروح

items.ar: لازم ما تشرب قهوة كثير، تخليك متوتر طول اليوم
items.en: You shouldn't drink too much coffee, it makes you nervous all day
items.translit: laazim ma tishrab gahwa katheer

items.ar: لازم ما تروح السوق بدون فلوس كافية، بترجع بدون شي
items.en: You shouldn't go to the market without enough money, you'll return without anything
items.translit: laazim ma truuH es-suug bidoon fluus kaafya

items.ar: لازم ما تشربين مويه باردة بعد الرياضة
items.en: You (f) shouldn't drink cold water right after exercise
items.translit: laazim ma tishrabeen moya baarda ba3d er-riyaada

items.ar: لازم ما يروح المجلس متأخر، الكل ينتظره ويصير متضايق
items.en: He shouldn't go to the majlis late, everyone waits for him and he feels embarrassed
items.translit: laazim ma yruuH el-majlis mit'akhkhir

lessons.title: She Shouldn't, We Shouldn't
lessons.titleNative: لازم ما تروح، لازم ما نروح

items.ar: لازم ما تسافر لوحدها بدون ما تتصل بأهلها أول
items.en: She shouldn't travel alone without informing her family first
items.translit: laazim ma tsaafir liwaHdaha bidoon ma tkhabbir ahlaha awwal

items.ar: لازم ما نصرف كل فلوسنا في يوم وحد، لازم نصرفها شوي شوي
items.en: We shouldn't spend all our money in one day, we should distribute it well
items.translit: laazim ma nisrif kil fluusana fi yoom waaHid

items.ar: لازم ما تروحون بيت جدكم بدون ما تتصلون أول
items.en: You all shouldn't go to your grandfather's house without calling first
items.translit: laazim ma truu7oon bayt jiddikum bidoon ma tittasiloon awwal

items.ar: لازم ما يشربون قهوة قبل النوم، ما بينامون زين
items.en: They shouldn't drink coffee before sleep, they won't sleep well
items.translit: laazim ma yishrabuun gahwa gabl en-nawm

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Want, You Shouldn't Know
lessons.titleNative: لازم ما تبغى، لازم ما تدري

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى كل شي مرة وحدة، الصبر مهم في الحياة
items.en: You shouldn't want everything at once, patience is important in life
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha kil shay marra waHda

items.ar: لازم ما تدري كل شي، بعض الأشياء أزيان لو ما تدريها
items.en: You shouldn't know everything, some things are better if you don't know them
items.translit: laazim ma tadri kil shay, ba3d el-ashyaa azyan law ma daraytha

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى بيت أكبر من دخلك، هذا بيخليك متضايق بعدين
items.en: You shouldn't want a house bigger than your income, this will make you upset
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha bayt akbar min dakhlak

items.ar: لازم ما تدري كل شي عن أصحابك، فيه أشياء خاصة
items.en: You shouldn't know everything about your friends, there are personal things
items.translit: laazim ma tadri kil shay 3an as7aabak

lessons.title: Not Because You're Tired, But Because Busy
lessons.titleNative: مب لأنك تعبان، بس لأنك مشغول

items.ar: لازم ما ترفض العرس مب لأنك تعبان، بس لأنك مشغول بشغل مهم
items.en: You shouldn't decline the wedding not because you're tired, but because you're busy with important work
items.translit: laazim ma tirfid el-3urs mub li-annak ta3baan

items.ar: مب لأنه غالي رفضنا البيت، بس لأن موقعه مب زين
items.en: It's not because it's expensive that we declined the house, but because its location isn't good
items.translit: mub li-annah ghaali rafadhna el-bayt

items.ar: لازم ما تلوم نفسك مب لأن الوضع صعب، بس لأنك سويت كل اللي تقدر عليه
items.en: You shouldn't blame yourself not because the situation is hard, but because you did all you could
items.translit: laazim ma tloom nafsak

items.ar: ما نجحت مب لأن الامتحان صعب، بس لأني ما درست كافي
items.en: I didn't succeed not because the exam was hard, but because I didn't study enough
items.translit: ma najaHt mub li-ann el-imtiHaan sa3ib

items.ar: لازم ما تصرف كل فلوسك على العرس، وفر شي للسفر بعدين
items.en: You shouldn't spend all your money on the wedding, leave something for travel later
items.translit: laazim ma tisrif kil fluusak 3alal-3urs

items.ar: لازم ما تدري كل شي عن أخوك، بعض الأشياء خاصة فيه
items.en: You shouldn't know everything about your brother, some things are private to him
items.translit: laazim ma tadri kil shay 3an akheek, ba3d el-ashyaa khaassa feeh

items.ar: مب لأنه بعيد ما رحنا، بس لأننا كنا متعبين من السفر
items.en: It's not because it's far that we didn't go, but because we were tired from the trip
items.translit: mub li-annah ba3eed ma riHna

items.ar: لازم ما تروح لوحدك بالليل، لازم يروح حد وياك أزيان
items.en: You shouldn't go alone at night, take someone with you for safety
items.translit: laazim ma truuH liwaHdak bil-layl

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Go to the Hospital

items.ar: لازم ما تروح المستشفى بدون موعد، بتنتظر ساعات طويلة
items.en: You shouldn't go to the hospital without an appointment, you'll wait for long hours
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-mustashfa bidoon maw3id

items.ar: لازم ما تاخذ الدوا بدون ما تسأل الطبيب أول
items.en: You shouldn't take the medicine without asking the doctor first about the dose
items.translit: laazim ma taakhudh ed-dawa bidoon ma tis'al eT-Tabeeb awwal

items.ar: لازم ما ترجع الشغل قبل ما تتحسن كامل، الجسم يحتاج وقت
items.en: You shouldn't return to work before you fully recover, the body needs time
items.translit: laazim ma tirja3 esh-shaghal gabl ma titHassan kaamil

items.ar: لازم ما تنسى ألم الظهر، لازم تشوف طبيب زين
items.en: You shouldn't neglect the back pain, you should see a specialist doctor
items.translit: laazim ma tuhmil alam edh-dhahr

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Go to Your Brother's House

items.ar: لازم ما تروح بيت أخوك بدون ما تتصل، ممكن يكون مشغول
items.en: You shouldn't go to your brother's house without calling, he might be busy
items.translit: laazim ma truuH bayt akhook bidoon ma tittasil

items.ar: لازم ما تلوم أختك على كل شي، هي تسوي اللي تقدر عليه
items.en: You shouldn't blame your sister for everything, she does what she can
items.translit: laazim ma tloom ukhtak 3ala kil shay

items.ar: لازم ما تقارن بين أولادك، كل واحد فيهم مختلف عن الثاني
items.en: You shouldn't compare between your children, each of them is different and special
items.translit: laazim ma tqaarin bayn awlaadak

items.ar: لازم ما تنسى تشكر جدك على كل اللي سواه لك
items.en: You shouldn't forget to thank your grandfather for everything he did for you
items.translit: laazim ma tinsa tishkur jiddak 3ala kil elli sawaah lak

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Want the Red House

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى البيت الأحمر بس لأن لونه حلو، شوف موقعه وسعره أول
items.en: You shouldn't want the red house just because its color is nice, look at its location and price first
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha el-bayt el-a7mar bas li-ann loonah 7ilu

items.ar: لازم ما تشري السيارة الغالية بدون ما تفكر بمشاكلها بعدين
items.en: You shouldn't buy the expensive car without thinking about maintenance later
items.translit: laazim ma tishri es-sayyaara el-ghaalya bidoon ma tfakkir bis-siyaana ba3dayn

items.ar: لازم ما تختار الشغل بس على الفلوس، فكر بالراحة والوقت كمان
items.en: You shouldn't choose the job just based on money, think about comfort and time too
items.translit: laazim ma tikhtaar esh-shughul bas 3alal-fluus

items.ar: لازم ما تختار المحل بس على شكله، شوف الأشياء فيه أول
items.en: You shouldn't choose the shop just based on its appearance, see the things in it first
items.translit: laazim ma tikhtaar el-maHal bas 3ala shaklah, shoof el-ashyaa feeh awwal

items.ar: لازم ما تروح بعيد بالليل بدون ما تخبر حد وين رايح
items.en: You shouldn't go far at night without telling someone where you're going
items.translit: laazim ma truuH ba3eed bil-layl bidoon ma tkhabbir Had wein raayiH

items.ar: لازم ما تمشي بعيد عن الطريق الأصلي، ممكن ما تلقى البيت
items.en: You shouldn't walk far from the main road, you might get lost
items.translit: laazim ma timshi ba3eed 3aniT-Tareeg el-asli

items.ar: لازم ما تسافر بعيد بدون فلوس كثير، ممكن تحتاج فلوس أكثر هناك
items.en: You shouldn't travel far without a lot of money, you might need more than you thought
items.translit: laazim ma tsaafir ba3eed bidoon fluus katheer

items.ar: لازم ما تنسى أهلك، لازم تزورهم كل جمعة عشان تقعدون سوا
items.en: You shouldn't forget your family, you must visit them every Friday so you sit together
items.translit: laazim ma tinsa ahlak, laazim tzoorhum kil jum3a 3ashaan tag3adoon sawa

items.ar: لازم ما تروح المستشفى بدون موعد، ولازم ما تنسى الألم الطويل
items.en: You shouldn't go to the hospital without an appointment, and shouldn't neglect long-lasting pain
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-mustashfa bidoon maw3id

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى البيت بس على لونه، فكر بالموقع والسعر زين
items.en: You shouldn't want the house just for its color, think well about the location and price
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha el-bayt bas 3ala loonah

items.ar: لازم ما تسافر بعيد بدون ما تخبر أهلك بمكانك
items.en: You shouldn't travel far without telling your family your location
items.translit: laazim ma tsaafir ba3eed bidoon ma tkhabbir ahlak bimakaanak

items.ar: لازم ما تلوم نفسك كثير، كل واحد يغلط أحيانا وهذا طبيعي
items.en: You shouldn't blame yourself too much, everyone makes mistakes sometimes and that's normal
items.translit: laazim ma tloom nafsak katheer

items.ar: لازم ما تاكل هذا اللحم، صار له في الثلاجة أسبوع كامل
items.en: You shouldn't eat this meat, it's been in the fridge for a whole week
items.translit: laazim ma taakil haadha el-la7am

items.ar: لازم ما تاكلين قبل الدوا مباشرة، انتظري نص ساعة أول
items.en: You (f) shouldn't eat right before the medicine, wait half an hour first
items.translit: laazim ma taakleen gabl ed-dawa mubaasharatan

items.ar: لازم ما ياكلون كل الحلو مرة وحدة، بيتعبون بعدين
items.en: They shouldn't eat all the dessert at once, their stomachs will hurt
items.translit: laazim ma yaakiloon kil el-Hilu marra waHda

items.ar: لازم ما نطبخ اللحم كثير، يصير مب لذيذ بعدين
items.en: We shouldn't overcook the meat, it becomes tough and doesn't turn out well
items.translit: laazim ma naTbakh el-la7am katheer

lessons.title: You All Shouldn't, They Shouldn't
lessons.titleNative: لازم ما تروحون، لازم ما يروحون

items.ar: لازم ما تروحون السوق قبل ما تفكرون بكل اللي تحتاجونه
items.en: You all shouldn't go to the market before thinking about everything you need
items.translit: laazim ma truu7oon es-suug gabl ma tfakkroon bikil elli taHtaajoonah

items.ar: لازم ما تدفعون كل الفلوس بدون ما تتأكدون من السعر الصح
items.en: You all shouldn't pay all the money without making sure of the right price
items.translit: laazim ma tidfa3oon kil el-fluus bidoon ma tit'akkadoon min es-si3ir es-saHH

items.ar: لازم ما يشرون البيت قبل ما يشوفونه مرة ثانية
items.en: They shouldn't buy the house before seeing it a second time
items.translit: laazim ma yishroon el-bayt gabl ma yshoofoonah marra thaanya

items.ar: لازم ما يقررون السفر بدون ما يدرسون كل شي زين
items.en: They shouldn't decide on the trip without studying all the details well
items.translit: laazim ma yqarriroon es-safar bidoon ma yadrusoon kil shay zayn

items.ar: لازم ما تروح البنك يوم الجمعة، هو مسكر يومها
items.en: You shouldn't go to the bank on Friday, it's closed that day
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-bank yoom el-jum3a

items.ar: لازم ما تسوي شي مهم يوم الاثنين، الزحمة قوية يومها
items.en: You shouldn't do anything important on Monday, the traffic is heavy that day
items.translit: laazim ma tsawwi shay muhim yoom el-ithnayn

items.ar: لازم ما تسافر يوم الخميس مساء، المطار يكون مليان ناس
items.en: You shouldn't travel Thursday evening, the airport is full of people
items.translit: laazim ma tsaafir yoom el-khamees masaa

items.ar: لازم ما تحجز موعد الطبيب آخر الأسبوع، بينتظرون كل الناس
items.en: You shouldn't book the doctor's appointment at the end of the week, everyone will be waiting
items.translit: laazim ma tiHjiz maw3id eT-Tabeeb aakhir el-isboo3

items.ar: لازم ما يكون عندك أكثر من عشرة قمصان، هذا كثير عليك
items.en: You shouldn't have more than ten shirts, that's too many for you
items.translit: laazim ma ykoon 3indak akthar min 3ashara gumsaan

items.ar: لازم ما تصرف أكثر من نص فلوسك على البيت
items.en: You shouldn't spend more than half your salary on rent
items.translit: laazim ma tisrif akthar min nus raatbak 3alal-eejaar

items.ar: لازم ما يكون عندك عشرين موعد بنفس اليوم، هذا كثير عليك
items.en: You shouldn't have twenty appointments on the same day, that's impossible
items.translit: laazim ma ykoon 3indak 3ishreen maw3id binafs el-yoom

items.ar: لازم ما تحط أكثر من كيلوين في الشنطة الصغيرة
items.en: You shouldn't carry more than two kilos in the small bag
items.translit: laazim ma tHummil akthar min keelowayn fish-shanTa es-sagheera

lessons.title: Review: Lazim Ma with Food, Days, Numbers

items.ar: لازم ما تاكل أكثر من صحن وحد، الأكل كثير مب زين للجسم
items.en: You shouldn't eat more than one plate, too much food isn't good for the body
items.translit: laazim ma taakil akthar min Tabag waaHid

items.ar: لازم ما تروح البنك يوم الجمعة لأنه مسكر، روح يوم السبت بدل
items.en: You shouldn't go to the bank on Friday because it's closed, go on Saturday instead
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-bank yoom el-jum3a li-annah mub maftooH

items.ar: لازم ما يكون عندك فلوس كثير بالبيت، حطها بالبنك أزيان
items.en: You shouldn't have excess money at home, put it in the bank instead
items.translit: laazim ma ykoon 3indak fluus zaayida bil-bayt

items.ar: لازم ما تشتري عشرة أشياء ما تحتاجها بس لأن السعر رخيص
items.en: You shouldn't buy ten things you don't need just because the price is cheap
items.translit: laazim ma tishtiri 3ashara ashyaa ma taHtaajha bas li-annes-si3ir rakhees

items.ar: لازم ما تزعل منه بسرعة، هو ما يبغى يخليك متضايق
items.en: You shouldn't get upset with him quickly, he doesn't want to bother you at all
items.translit: laazim ma tiz3al minnah bisur3a, huwa ma yibgha ydaayigak abadan

items.ar: لازم ما تزعلين من كل شي يقولونه، بعض الناس بس يتكلمون كذا دايما
items.en: You (f) shouldn't get upset at everything they say, some people just talk without meaning it
items.translit: laazim ma tiz3aleen min kil shay yguuloonah

items.ar: لازم ما نقلق كثير على النتيجة، سوينا كل اللي نقدر عليه
items.en: We shouldn't worry too much about the result, we did all we could
items.translit: laazim ma niqlaq katheer 3alan-nateeja

items.ar: لازم ما يتوترون قبل الاجتماع، لو يدرسون زين، كل شي بيصير أسهل
items.en: They shouldn't get nervous before the meeting, good preparation makes everything easier
items.translit: laazim ma yitwattaroon gabl el-ijtimaa3

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Go to the Doctor Tired

items.ar: لازم ما تروح الطبيب وانت تعبان كثير، خذ راحة يوم أول
items.en: You shouldn't go to the doctor while you're extremely tired, take a day of rest first
items.translit: laazim ma truuH eT-Tabeeb wa inta ta3baan jiddan

items.ar: لازم ما تسوق وانت متعب، مب زين عليك وعلى الناس الثانية
items.en: You shouldn't drive while you're tired, it's dangerous for you and others
items.translit: laazim ma tsoog wa inta mut3ab

items.ar: لازم ما تدرس وانت جوعان، ما بتقدر تفهم زين
items.en: You shouldn't study while you're hungry, you won't be able to focus well
items.translit: laazim ma tadrus wa inta joo3aan

items.ar: لازم ما تقرر شي مهم وانت زعلان، انتظر لين تصير زين
items.en: You shouldn't decide anything important while you're upset, wait until you calm down
items.translit: laazim ma tqarrir shay muhim wa inta za3laan

items.ar: لازم ما تروح يمين هناك، الطريق مسكر اليوم
items.en: You shouldn't go right there, the road is closed because of maintenance
items.translit: laazim ma truuH yameen hinaak

items.ar: لازم ما تاخذ الطريق القديم، الجديد أسرع وأسهل بكثير
items.en: You shouldn't take the old road, the new one is much faster and easier
items.translit: laazim ma taakhudh eT-Tareeg el-gadeem

items.ar: لازم ما توقف قدام البيت مباشرة، وقف شوي بعيد
items.en: You shouldn't stop right in front of the house, stop a bit farther away
items.translit: laazim ma toogaf guddaam el-bayt mubaasharatan

items.ar: لازم ما تدخل من الباب الثاني، هذا الباب زين ومفتوح دايما
items.en: You shouldn't enter from the other door, this door is good and always open
items.translit: laazim ma tudkhul minal-baab eth-thaani

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Want the Old House

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى البيت القديم بس لأنه رخيص، شوف البيت زين أول
items.en: You shouldn't want the old house just because it's cheap, check its condition first
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha el-bayt el-gadeem bas li-annah rakhees

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى كل الأشياء القديمة، بعضها ما تحتاجه أبدا
items.en: You shouldn't want all the old things, some of them you never need
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha kil el-ashyaa el-gadeema

items.ar: لازم ما تقارن سيارتك القديمة بسيارة صاحبك الجديدة
items.en: You shouldn't compare your old car to your friend's new car
items.translit: laazim ma tqaarin sayyaaratak el-gadeema bisayyaarat saaHbak el-jideeda

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى الطريقة القديمة لو فيه طريقة أزيان وأسرع
items.en: You shouldn't want the old way if there's a better and faster way
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha eT-Tareega el-gadeema

items.ar: لازم ما تروح الطبيب وانت تعبان، ولازم ما تسوق وانت متعب
items.en: You shouldn't go to the doctor while tired, and shouldn't drive while exhausted
items.translit: laazim ma truuH eT-Tabeeb wa inta ta3baan

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى البيت القديم بس لأنه رخيص، شكله أهم من السعر
items.en: You shouldn't want the old house just because it's cheap, condition matters more than price
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha el-bayt el-gadeem bas li-annah rakhees

items.ar: لازم ما تزعل من كل كلمة، الحياة فيها أشياء كثير ما تستاهل الزعل
items.en: You shouldn't get upset at every word, life has a lot of talk that isn't worth getting upset over
items.translit: laazim ma tiz3al min kil kilma

items.ar: لازم ما تدخل من الباب الثاني وانت ما تعرف صاحب البيت زين
items.en: You shouldn't enter from the back door if you don't know the house owner well
items.translit: laazim ma tudkhul minal-baab el-khalfi

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Go to Your Sister's House Tired
lessons.titleNative: لازم ما تروح بيت أختك تعبان

items.ar: لازم ما تروح بيت أختك وانت تعبان، خذ راحة أول وبعدين روح لها
items.en: You shouldn't go to your sister's house while tired, rest first and then visit her
items.translit: laazim ma truuH bayt ukhtak wa inta ta3baan

items.ar: لازم ما تتكلمين مع خالتك وانتي زعلانة، انتظري تصيرين زينة أول
items.en: You (f) shouldn't talk to your maternal aunt while upset, wait until you calm down first
items.translit: laazim ma titkallmeen ma3 khaaltik wa inti za3laana

items.ar: لازم ما نقرر شي عن الأولاد واحنا زعلانين، لازم نصير زينين أول
items.en: We shouldn't decide anything about the children while we're upset, we must be fine first
items.translit: laazim ma nqarrir shay 3anil-awlaad wa niHna za3laaneen

items.ar: لازم ما يزورون جدهم وهم مستعجلين، هو يحب يقعد وياهم وقت طويل
items.en: They shouldn't visit their grandfather while in a hurry, he loves long sittings
items.translit: laazim ma yzooroon jiddahum wa hum musta3jileen

lessons.title: You Shouldn't Want Your Brother's Car

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى سيارة أخوك، اشتغل وشري سيارتك الخاصة
items.en: You shouldn't want your brother's car, work and get your own car
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha sayyaarat akhook

items.ar: لازم ما تقارن شغلك بشغل صديقك، كل واحد له طريقه
items.en: You shouldn't compare your job to your friend's job, each one has their own path
items.translit: laazim ma tqaarin shughlak bishughul saaHbak

items.ar: لازم ما تزعلين من أختك لأنها نجحت، لازم تكونين مبسوطة لها
items.en: You (f) shouldn't be upset with your sister because she succeeded, you should be happy for her
items.translit: laazim ma tiz3aleen min ukhtik li-annaha najHat, laazim tkooneen mabsoota laha

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى بيت مثل بيت الجيران، بيتك زين ويناسبك
items.en: You shouldn't want a house like the neighbors' house, your house is good and suits you
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha bayt mithil bayt el-jeeraan

items.ar: ما أحتاج أدري كل التفاصيل، بس أدري النتيجة كافي لي
items.en: I don't need to know all the details, just knowing the result is enough for me
items.translit: ma aHtaaj adri kil shay

items.ar: ما تحتاجين تدرين كل شي عنه، هو صار شخص ثاني الحين
items.en: You (f) don't need to know everything about him, he became a different person now
items.translit: ma taHtaajeen tadreen kil shay 3annah, huwa saar shakhs thaani el-heen

items.ar: ما نحتاج ندري السبب الحقيقي، بس نقبل قراره
items.en: We don't need to know the real reason, we just respect his decision
items.translit: ma naHtaaj nadri es-sabab el-Hageeqi

items.ar: ما يحتاجون يدرون كل شي، بس المهم يكفيهم
items.en: They don't need to know our whole plan, just the important part is enough for them
items.translit: ma yaHtaajoon yidroon kil khiTTatna

lessons.title: A Full Day of Lazim Ma

items.ar: لازم ما تصحى متأخر، ولازم تاكل فطورك، ولازم ما تتأخر عن الشغل
items.en: You shouldn't wake up late, shouldn't skip breakfast, and shouldn't be late for work
items.translit: laazim ma tSHa mit'akhkhir

items.ar: لازم ما تدرس طول الليل بدون راحة، ولازم ما تنسى تاكل بين الدروس
items.en: You shouldn't study all night without rest, and shouldn't forget to eat between lessons
items.translit: laazim ma tadrus Tool el-layl bidoon raaHa

items.ar: لازم ما تطبخ وانت مستعجل، ولازم ما تنسى شي بالمطبخ قبل ما تطلع
items.en: You shouldn't cook while in a hurry, and shouldn't forget anything in the kitchen before you leave
items.translit: laazim ma taTbakh wa inta musta3jil

items.ar: لازم ما تسافر بدون راحة كافية، ولازم ما تنسى محفظتك ومفتاحك
items.en: You shouldn't travel without enough rest, and shouldn't forget your important papers
items.translit: laazim ma tsaafir bidoon raaHa kaafya

lessons.title: Review: Lazim Ma with Family, Know, Drink

items.ar: لازم ما تدري كل شي عن العائلة، بعض الأشياء أزيان لو ما تدريها
items.en: You shouldn't know everything about the family, some things are better if you don't know them
items.translit: laazim ma tadri kil shay 3anil-ahl

items.ar: لازم ما تشرب قهوة كثير وانت متوتر، هذا بيخليك متوتر أكثر بس
items.en: You shouldn't drink a lot of coffee while nervous, this only increases the nervousness
items.translit: laazim ma tishrab gahwa katheer wa inta mutawattir

items.ar: لازم ما تلوم جدتك على طريقتها القديمة، هي من زمان ثاني
items.en: You shouldn't blame your grandmother for her old-fashioned way, she's from another era
items.translit: laazim ma tloom jiddatak 3ala Tareegatha el-gadeema

items.ar: لازم ما نحكم على أحد قبل ما نعرف قصته كاملة
items.en: We shouldn't judge someone before knowing his whole story
items.translit: laazim ma naHkum 3ala aHad gabl ma na3rif gissatah kaamila

items.ar: لازم ما تقعد طول اليوم بدون ما تمشي، لازم تمشي شوي كل ساعة
items.en: You shouldn't sit all day without movement, you should walk a bit every hour
items.translit: laazim ma tag3ad Tool el-yoom bidoon Haraka

items.ar: لازم ما تشتغل بدون فطور، الجسم يحتاج أكل عشان يشتغل زين
items.en: You shouldn't work without breakfast, the body needs energy in order to focus
items.translit: laazim ma tashtaghil bidoon futoor

items.ar: لازم ما تروح النوم وانت زعلان، افهم المشكلة قبل ما تنام
items.en: You shouldn't go to sleep while upset, understand the problem before you sleep
items.translit: laazim ma truuH en-nawm wa inta za3laan

items.ar: لازم ما تفكر بيوم بكرا بدون ما تخلص شغل اليوم أول
items.en: You shouldn't think about tomorrow's day without finishing today's work first
items.translit: laazim ma tfakkir biyoom bukra bidoon ma tkhallis shughul el-yoom awwal

items.ar: لازم ما تروح المطار بدون ما تتأكد من وقت الطيارة الصح
items.en: You shouldn't go to the airport without making sure of the flight's correct time
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-mataar bidoon ma tit'akkad min wagt er-riHla es-saHH

items.ar: لازم ما توقف بالسيارة قدام باب المسجد، وقف بعيد شوي أزيان
items.en: You shouldn't stop the car in front of the mosque door, stop a bit farther away, better
items.translit: laazim ma toogaf bis-sayyaara guddaam baab el-masjid

items.ar: لازم ما تدخل المطبخ وانت وسخ من الشغل الطويل
items.en: You shouldn't enter the kitchen while dirty from outdoor work
items.translit: laazim ma tudkhul el-matbakh wa inta wisikh min esh-shughul el-khaariji

items.ar: لازم ما تروح المجلس بدون ما تسلم على كل واحد فيه
items.en: You shouldn't go to the majlis without greeting everyone in it
items.translit: laazim ma truuH el-majlis bidoon ma tsallim 3ala kil waaHid feeh

items.ar: لازم ما تصرف كل فلوسك بيوم وحد، وفر شي دايما
items.en: You shouldn't spend all your money in one day, always save something
items.translit: laazim ma tisrif kil fluusak biyoom waaHid

items.ar: لازم ما تدفع قبل ما تشوف الشي وتتأكد إنه زين
items.en: You shouldn't pay before seeing the item and making sure it's good
items.translit: laazim ma tidfa3 gabl ma tshoof esh-shay wa tit'akkad innah zayn

items.ar: لازم ما تنسى تدري كل الفلوس قبل ما تقرر السعر
items.en: You shouldn't forget to calculate all the money before setting the price
items.translit: laazim ma tinsa tHassib kil el-fluus gabl ma tHaddid es-si3ir

items.ar: لازم ما تشري كل شي غالي بس عشان أصحابك يشرونه
items.en: You shouldn't buy everything expensive just because your friends buy it
items.translit: laazim ma tishri kil shay ghaali bas 3ashaan as7aabak yishroonah

items.ar: لازم ما تحس متضايق من قرار سويته وانت تدري الوضع زين
items.en: You shouldn't feel bad about a decision you made while understanding the situation well
items.translit: laazim ma tHiss mutadaayig min qaraar sawwaytah

items.ar: لازم ما تخاف من الامتحان الصعب، درست زين وتقدر عليه
items.en: You shouldn't fear the difficult exam, you studied well and you can handle it
items.translit: laazim ma tkhaaf minal-imtiHaan es-sa3ib

items.ar: لازم ما تقارن نفسك بالثانيين طول الوقت، كل واحد له طريقه
items.en: You shouldn't compare yourself to others all the time, each person has their own path
items.translit: laazim ma tqaarin nafsak bith-thaanyeen Tool el-wagt

items.ar: لازم ما تقعد وحدك مع مشكلتك، تكلم مع صاحبك أو أهلك
items.en: You shouldn't always suppress your feelings, talk to your friend or your family
items.translit: laazim ma tiktum mashaa3irak dayman, tkallam ma3 saaHbak aw ahlak

items.ar: لازم ما تصرف كل فلوسك بيوم وحد، ولازم ما تنسى تدري كل شي زين
items.en: You shouldn't spend all your money in one day, and shouldn't forget to calculate everything well
items.translit: laazim ma tisrif kil fluusak biyoom waaHid

items.ar: لازم ما تخاف من الامتحان، ولازم ما تقارن نفسك بالثانيين
items.en: You shouldn't fear the exam, and shouldn't compare yourself to others
items.translit: laazim ma tkhaaf minal-imtiHaan, wa laazim ma tqaarin nafsak bith-thaanyeen

items.ar: لازم ما تحكم على أحد بسرعة، اسأله ليش سوى كذا أول
items.en: You shouldn't judge someone quickly, ask him why he did that first
items.translit: laazim ma taHkum 3ala aHad bisur3a

items.ar: لازم ما تنسى إن العائلة أهم من أي شي ثاني
items.en: You shouldn't forget that family is more important than anything else
items.translit: laazim ma tinsa inn el-ahl ahamm min ay shay thaani

items.ar: متوتر كثير قبل الامتحان، بس أفكر بأشياء زينة عشان أرتاح
items.en: I'm very nervous before the exam, but I try to think of things that relax me
items.translit: mutawattir katheer gabl el-imtiHaan

items.ar: قلقانة على ابنها، بس ما تبين قلقها له
items.en: She's worried about her son, but she tries not to show her worry to him
items.translit: galgaana 3ala waladha

items.ar: متضايقين من الشغل الكثير، بس نرتاح كل جمعة زين
items.en: We're upset about the excessive work, but we try to rest every Friday
items.translit: mutadaayigeen minesh-shughul el-katheer

items.ar: فخورين كثير لأن السنة كانت صعبة وصبرنا زين
items.en: We're proud of ourselves because we got through a very difficult year
items.translit: fakhooreen bi-anfusna li-annana tjaawazna sana sa3ba katheer

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى ملابس غالية بس عشان اسمها زين
items.en: You shouldn't want expensive clothes just because their name is famous
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha malaabis ghaalya bas 3ashaan ismha mash-hoor

items.ar: لازم ما تشرين عباية جديدة كل شهر، وفري فلوسك أزيان
items.en: You shouldn't buy a new abaya every month, save your money instead
items.translit: laazim ma tishreen 3abaaya jideeda kil shahar

items.ar: لازم ما تلبس نفس القميص كل يوم للاجتماعات
items.en: You shouldn't wear the same shirt every day for meetings
items.translit: laazim ma tilbas nafs el-gamees kil yoom lil-ijtimaa3aat

items.ar: لازم ما تحكم على الناس من ملابسهم بس، شوف شنو فيهم
items.en: You shouldn't judge people just by their clothes, look at their heart
items.translit: laazim ma taHkum 3alan-naas min malaabishum bas

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى جوتي جديد كل شهر، الجوتي الزين يبقى زين سنين
items.en: You shouldn't want new shoes every month, good shoes last for years
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha jooti jideed kil shahar

items.ar: لازم ما تشري غترة غالية بدون ما تقارن الأسعار بمحلات ثانية
items.en: You shouldn't buy an expensive headdress without comparing prices at other shops
items.translit: laazim ma tishri ghitra ghaalya bidoon ma tqaarin el-as3aar bima7allaat thaanya

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى بس لون واحد بملابسها، عندها ألوان جديدة كثير
items.en: She shouldn't want only one color for her clothes, she has a lot of new colors
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha bas loon waaHid bimalaabisha

items.ar: لازم ما نشري ملابس كثير للعرس، البسيط أحيانا أزيان وأنيق
items.en: We shouldn't overdo the clothes for the wedding, the simple is sometimes better and more elegant
items.translit: laazim ma nbaalig fil-malaabis lil-3urs

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى أكل جاهز كل يوم، الأكل البيتي أزيان وألذ
items.en: You shouldn't want ready-made food every day, home-cooked food is better and tastier
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha akal jaahiz kil yoom

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى أكل غالي بس عشان اسم المطعم مشهور
items.en: You (f) shouldn't want expensive food just because the restaurant's name is famous
items.translit: laazim ma tibgheen akal ghaali bas 3ashaan ism el-mat3am mash-hoor

items.ar: لازم ما نطلب أكل كثير للعرس بدون ما نفكر بعدد الضيوف
items.en: We shouldn't order too much food for the wedding without thinking about the number of guests
items.translit: laazim ma niTlub akal katheer lil-3urs bidoon ma nfakkir bi3adad edh-dhuyoof

items.ar: لازم ما يبغى حلو بعد كل وجبة، هذا مب زين له
items.en: They shouldn't want dessert after every meal, this isn't good for them
items.translit: laazim ma yibghoon Hilu ba3d kil wajba

items.ar: لازم ما تبغى تجرب كل أكلة جديدة مرة وحدة، جرب شوي شوي
items.en: You shouldn't want to try every new dish at once, try little by little
items.translit: laazim ma tibgha tjarrib kil akla jideeda marra waHda

items.ar: لازم ما تطبخين للضيوف أكل ما تعرفينه، جربيه على العائلة أول
items.en: You (f) shouldn't cook food you don't know for the guests, try it on the family first
items.translit: laazim ma taTbakheen lidh-dhuyoof akal ma ta3rifeenah

items.ar: لازم ما نأكل بسرعة في العرس، خذ وقتك زين
items.en: We shouldn't eat quickly at the wedding, take your time
items.translit: laazim ma na'kul bisur3a fil-3urs, khudh wagtak zayn

items.ar: لازم ما تشري تمر كثير بدون ما تسأل عن تاريخه
items.en: You shouldn't buy a lot of dates without asking about their date
items.translit: laazim ma tishri tamur katheer bidoon ma tis'al 3an taareekhah

lessons.title: Too Many Choices at the Mall
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the overwhelming variety of modern shopping.

paragraphs.ar: رحت أشتري قميص وطلعت من المول بدون ما أشتري شي.
paragraphs.en: I went to buy a shirt and left the mall without buying anything.

paragraphs.ar: كل محل فيه مية نوع قميص، وضعت وأنا أفكر أي وحد أختار.
paragraphs.en: Every shop has a hundred types of shirts, and I got lost thinking which one to choose.

paragraphs.ar: زمان كان الاختيار أبسط، بس الحين صار الخيار الكثير نفسه مشكلة.
paragraphs.en: In the past, choosing was simpler, but now the abundance of choice itself has become a problem.

paragraphs.ar: تعلمت إن أحيانا الأبسط أحسن، حتى لو الخيارات أقل.
paragraphs.en: I learned that sometimes simpler is better, even with fewer options.

questions.question: What happened at the mall?
options: The speaker left without buying anything

questions.question: Why did the speaker feel lost?
options: Too many types of shirts to choose from

questions.question: How was choosing in the past, according to the speaker?
What did the speaker learn?
options: Sometimes simpler is better, even with fewer options
Shopping is a waste of time

lessons.title: Why Our Hospitality Runs Deep
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the roots of Gulf hospitality culture.

paragraphs.ar: عادة الكرم عندنا مب بس تقديم قهوة وتمر، هي شعور بالمسؤولية تجاه الضيف.
paragraphs.en: The custom of hospitality for us isn't just offering coffee and dates, it's a sense of responsibility toward the guest.

paragraphs.ar: زمان بالصحراء، الضيافة كانت مسألة بقاء، لأن المسافر يحتاج ماء وطعام ومأوى.
paragraphs.en: Long ago in the desert, hospitality was a matter of survival, because a traveler needed water, food, and shelter.

paragraphs.ar: هالقيمة انتقلت من جيل لجيل حتى صارت جزء من هويتنا.
paragraphs.en: This value passed from generation to generation until it became part of our identity.

paragraphs.ar: لين اليوم، نستقبل أي ضيف بأحسن ما عندنا، حتى لو ما نعرفه.
paragraphs.en: Even today, we welcome any guest with the best we have, even if we don't know them.

questions.question: What is hospitality for the speaker's culture?
options: A sense of responsibility toward the guest

questions.question: What was hospitality in the desert long ago?
How did this value spread?
How do they treat guests today?
options: Any guest, even strangers, with the best they have

lessons.title: Skyscrapers and Old Neighborhoods
lessons.context: A reflective passage on rapid development versus heritage preservation.

paragraphs.ar: المدينة اللي كبرت فيها تغيرت بشكل ما كنت أتخيله.
paragraphs.en: The city I grew up in has changed in a way I couldn't have imagined.

paragraphs.ar: مكان بيت جدي القديم، الحين فيه برج شاهق وحديث.
paragraphs.en: Where my grandfather's old house used to be, there's now a tall, modern tower.

paragraphs.ar: أفهم إن التطور مهم، بس أحس بحزن خفيف كل ما أفتقد الأماكن القديمة.
paragraphs.en: I understand that development is important, but I feel a slight sadness whenever I miss the old places.

paragraphs.ar: لحسن الحظ، بعض المناطق التراثية انحفظت عشان الأجيال الجاية تشوفها.
paragraphs.en: Fortunately, some heritage areas have been preserved so future generations can see them.

questions.question: How has the speaker's city changed?
options: In ways they couldn't have imagined

questions.question: What replaced the grandfather's old house?
How does the speaker feel about this?
options: A slight sadness, while understanding development

questions.question: What has fortunately been preserved?

lessons.title: The Majlis as an Informal Parliament
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the community role of the majlis in decision-making.

paragraphs.ar: المجلس عندنا مب بس مكان للسوالف، هو مكان يتناقش فيه الناس بقضايا المجتمع.
paragraphs.en: The majlis for us isn't just a place for chatting, it's a place where people discuss community issues.

paragraphs.ar: لما يصير خلاف بين جيران أو أفراد عائلة، يجتمعون بالمجلس يحلونه بالكلام.
paragraphs.en: When a dispute arises between neighbors or family members, they gather at the majlis to resolve it through discussion.

paragraphs.ar: كبار السن يستمعون للطرفين ويحاولون يوصلون لحل يرضي الجميع.
paragraphs.en: The elders listen to both sides and try to reach a solution that satisfies everyone.

paragraphs.ar: هالتقليد يعكس قيمة قديمة: إن الحكمة تجي من الاستماع مب بس من السلطة.
paragraphs.en: This tradition reflects an old value: that wisdom comes from listening, not just from authority.

questions.question: What is the majlis besides a place to chat?
options: A place to discuss community issues

questions.question: What happens when a dispute arises?
options: People gather at the majlis to resolve it

questions.question: What do the elders do?
options: Listen to both sides and seek a satisfying solution

questions.question: What value does this tradition reflect?

lessons.title: Balancing Local and Foreign Talent
lessons.context: A reflective passage on national workforce development policy.

paragraphs.ar: بلدنا يشجع المواطنين يدخلون القطاع الخاص أكثر من قبل.
paragraphs.en: Our country encourages citizens to enter the private sector more than before.

paragraphs.ar: هالسياسة تحاول توازن بين خلق فرص للمواطنين والاستفادة من خبرة الكفاءات الأجنبية.
paragraphs.en: This policy tries to balance creating opportunities for citizens and benefiting from the expertise of foreign talent.

paragraphs.ar: بعض الشركات وفرت برامج تدريب للمواطنين الجدد بسوق العمل.
paragraphs.en: Some companies have provided training programs for citizens new to the job market.

paragraphs.ar: أشوف إن هالتوازن مهم عشان الاقتصاد يستمر بالنمو والتنوع.
paragraphs.en: I see that this balance is important for the economy to continue growing and diversifying.

questions.question: What does the country encourage citizens to do?
What does this policy try to balance?
options: Opportunities for citizens and foreign expertise

questions.question: What have some companies provided?
options: Training programs for new citizen workers

questions.question: Why does the speaker see this balance as important?
options: For the economy to keep growing and diversifying

lessons.title: Lessons from Bedouin Resilience
lessons.context: A reflective passage on resilience lessons from desert heritage.

paragraphs.ar: أجدادنا عاشوا بظروف صحراوية قاسية بدون كثير من وسائل الراحة الحديثة.
paragraphs.en: Our ancestors lived in harsh desert conditions without many modern comforts.

paragraphs.ar: تعلموا يتأقلمون مع قلة الموارد ويحلون مشاكلهم بذكاء وصبر.
paragraphs.en: They learned to adapt to scarce resources and solve their problems with intelligence and patience.

paragraphs.ar: أعتقد إن هالصفات، الصبر والتأقلم، لسا مهمة اليوم حتى بحياتنا المريحة.
paragraphs.en: I believe these qualities, patience and adaptability, are still important today even in our comfortable lives.

paragraphs.ar: لما أواجه تحدي بحياتي، أتذكر صمود أجدادي وأستمد منه قوة.
paragraphs.en: When I face a challenge in my life, I remember my ancestors' resilience and draw strength from it.

questions.question: How did the ancestors live?
What did they learn to do?
options: Adapt to scarce resources with intelligence and patience

questions.question: What does the speaker believe about these qualities today?
What does the speaker do when facing a challenge?
options: Remembers their ancestors' resilience for strength

lessons.title: From the Souk to Online Shopping
lessons.context: A reflective passage on changing consumer habits.

paragraphs.ar: زمان كنا نروح السوق نشتري كل شي وجه لوجه مع البياع.
paragraphs.en: In the past, we used to go to the souk to buy everything face to face with the seller.

paragraphs.ar: الحين صار وايد من التسوق يصير من التلفون بضغطة زر.
paragraphs.en: Now a lot of shopping happens from the phone with the push of a button.

paragraphs.ar: سهل وسريع، بس أحيانا أفتقد التجربة الإنسانية بالسوق القديم.
paragraphs.en: It's easy and fast, but sometimes I miss the human experience of the old souk.

paragraphs.ar: أحاول أوازن بين الاثنين: أشتري أونلاين للسرعة، وأزور السوق للأجواء.
paragraphs.en: I try to balance the two: I buy online for speed, and visit the souk for the atmosphere.

options: Face to face with the seller at the souk

questions.question: How does shopping happen now?
options: From the phone, with a button push

questions.question: What does the speaker miss?
options: The human experience of the old souk

questions.question: How does the speaker balance the two?
options: Online for speed, souk for atmosphere

lessons.title: Generosity as a Way of Life
lessons.context: A reflective passage on generosity as a deeply held cultural value.

paragraphs.ar: الكرم عندنا مب مجرد عادة اجتماعية، هو قيمة مرتبطة بديننا وتربيتنا.
paragraphs.en: Generosity for us isn't just a social custom, it's a value connected to our religion and upbringing.

paragraphs.ar: تربينا نشارك اللي عندنا مع الجيران والمحتاجين بدون ما ننتظر شي بالمقابل.
paragraphs.en: We were raised to share what we have with neighbors and those in need, without expecting anything in return.

paragraphs.ar: حتى بأصعب الظروف، أهلنا يعلمونا نبقى كرماء ونفكر بغيرنا.
paragraphs.en: Even in the hardest circumstances, our parents teach us to remain generous and think of others.

paragraphs.ar: أشوف إن هالقيمة تخلي مجتمعنا أقوى وأكثر ترابط.
paragraphs.en: I see that this value makes our community stronger and more connected.

questions.question: What is generosity for the speaker's culture?
options: A value connected to religion and upbringing

questions.question: What were they raised to do?
options: Share with neighbors and those in need

questions.question: What do parents teach even in hard circumstances?
options: To remain generous and think of others

questions.question: What does this value do for the community?
options: Makes it stronger and more connected

lessons.title: Cars, Roads, and the Idea of Public Transport
lessons.context: A reflective passage on car culture and the growth of public transit options.

paragraphs.ar: زمان، السيارة الخاصة كانت الخيار الوحيد تقريبا للتنقل.
paragraphs.en: In the past, the private car was almost the only option for getting around.

paragraphs.ar: الحين صارت فيه خيارات نقل عام أكثر زي المترو والباصات الحديثة.
paragraphs.en: Now there are more public transport options like the metro and modern buses.

paragraphs.ar: جربت المترو مرة وفاجأني كم كان مريح وسريع.
paragraphs.en: I tried the metro once and was surprised by how comfortable and fast it was.

paragraphs.ar: أعتقد إن تنوع وسائل النقل يخلي المدينة أسهل وأنظف بيئيا.
paragraphs.en: I believe the diversity of transport options makes the city easier and more environmentally clean.

questions.question: What was almost the only transport option in the past?
What options exist now?
How did the speaker find the metro?
What does the speaker believe transport diversity does?
options: Makes the city easier and cleaner

lessons.title: Hosting the World
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the experience of hosting international events.

paragraphs.ar: لما بلدنا استضاف حدث عالمي كبير، شفت فخر كبير بعيون الكل.
paragraphs.en: When our country hosted a big international event, I saw great pride in everyone's eyes.

paragraphs.ar: ناس من كل الدنيا زارونا وشافوا ثقافتنا وضيافتنا عن قرب.
paragraphs.en: People from all over the world visited us and saw our culture and hospitality up close.

paragraphs.ar: تطوعت بالحدث والتقيت ناس من جنسيات ما كنت أعرف عنها شي.
paragraphs.en: I volunteered at the event and met people from nationalities I knew nothing about.

paragraphs.ar: هالتجربة وسعت أفقي وخلتني أفتخر أكثر ببلدي.
paragraphs.en: This experience broadened my perspective and made me even more proud of my country.

questions.question: What did the speaker see in everyone's eyes?
What did visitors from around the world see?
options: Their culture and hospitality up close

questions.question: What did the speaker do?
How did this experience affect the speaker?
options: Broadened their perspective and increased pride

lessons.title: Preserving Nabati Poetry
lessons.context: A reflective passage on preserving traditional oral poetry.

paragraphs.ar: الشعر النبطي كان وسيلة أجدادنا يعبرون فيها عن مشاعرهم وحكمتهم.
paragraphs.en: Nabati poetry was the way our ancestors expressed their feelings and wisdom.

paragraphs.ar: جدي يحفظ قصايد وايد ويلقيها بالمناسبات العائلية.
paragraphs.en: My grandfather memorizes many poems and recites them at family occasions.

paragraphs.ar: للأسف، جيل الشباب ما وايد يهتم بهالفن مثل الأجيال اللي طافت.
paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, the younger generation isn't as interested in this art as past generations.

paragraphs.ar: صارت فيه برامج تلفزيونية تحاول تحيي هالتراث وتقرب الشباب منه.
paragraphs.en: There are now TV programs trying to revive this heritage and bring young people closer to it.

questions.question: What does the grandfather do?
options: Memorizes and recites poems at family occasions

questions.question: How interested is the younger generation?
options: Not as interested as past generations

questions.question: What are TV programs trying to do?
options: Revive the heritage and interest young people

lessons.title: Minimalism and the Old Idea of Showing Wealth
lessons.context: A reflective passage on shifting attitudes toward material display.

paragraphs.ar: زمان كان الناس يظهرون غناهم بأشياء كبيرة ولافتة للنظر.
paragraphs.en: In the past, people used to show their wealth with big, eye-catching things.

paragraphs.ar: الحين لاحظت إن جيل الشباب يميل أكثر للبساطة بحياته اليومية.
paragraphs.en: Now I've noticed that the younger generation leans more toward simplicity in daily life.

paragraphs.ar: أصحابي يفضلون يصرفون فلوسهم على تجارب وسفر بدل أشياء مادية.
paragraphs.en: My friends prefer to spend their money on experiences and travel instead of material things.

paragraphs.ar: أعتقد إن هذا يعكس تغير بمفهوم النجاح، من المظهر للمعنى.
paragraphs.en: I believe this reflects a change in the concept of success, from appearance to meaning.

questions.question: How did people used to show their wealth?
What has the speaker noticed about the younger generation?
What do the speaker's friends prefer to spend money on?
What does this reflect, according to the speaker?
options: A shift in the concept of success

lessons.title: A Kitchen of Many Influences
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the evolving flavors of Gulf cuisine.

paragraphs.ar: مطبخنا اليوم فيه مزيج من نكهات هندية وفارسية وعربية.
paragraphs.en: Our cuisine today has a mix of Indian, Persian, and Arab flavors.

paragraphs.ar: هالتنوع جا من قرون من التجارة والتواصل مع دول ثانية عبر البحر.
paragraphs.en: This diversity came from centuries of trade and connection with other countries across the sea.

paragraphs.ar: لما آكل مجبوس، أحس إني آكل قطعة من تاريخ بلدي.
paragraphs.en: When I eat machboos, I feel like I'm eating a piece of my country's history.

paragraphs.ar: أعتقد إن الأكل طريقة حلوة نفهم فيها كيف تشكلت هويتنا.
paragraphs.en: I believe food is a nice way to understand how our identity was formed.

options: Centuries of trade across the sea

questions.question: What does eating machboos feel like?
options: Eating a piece of the country's history

lessons.title: Raising Children Between Languages
lessons.context: A reflective passage on raising multilingual children.

paragraphs.ar: أولادي يتكلمون عربي بالبيت وإنجليزي بالمدرسة.
paragraphs.en: My children speak Arabic at home and English at school.

paragraphs.ar: أحيانا يخلطون بين اللغتين، وهذا طبيعي بمرحلة تعلمهم.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes they mix the two languages, and this is normal at their learning stage.

paragraphs.ar: أحرص إني أحكي معهم عربي فصيح ولهجتنا عشان ما ينسون أصلهم.
paragraphs.en: I make sure to speak to them in proper Arabic and our dialect so they don't forget their roots.

paragraphs.ar: أشوف إن إتقان لغتين نعمة كبيرة بتفتح لهم أبواب وايد بالمستقبل.
paragraphs.en: I see mastering two languages as a great blessing that will open many doors for them in the future.

questions.question: What languages do the children speak?
options: Arabic at home and English at school

questions.question: What happens sometimes with the languages?
options: They mix the two languages, which is normal

questions.question: What does the speaker make sure to do?
options: Speak proper Arabic and dialect with them

questions.question: How does the speaker see bilingualism?
options: As a great blessing for the future

lessons.title: A Gap Year Before University
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the debate over taking a year off before college.

paragraphs.ar: بعد الثانوية، فكرت آخذ سنة فراغ قبل ما أدخل الجامعة.
paragraphs.en: After high school, I thought about taking a gap year before entering university.

paragraphs.ar: أهلي في الأول ما تحمسوا للفكرة، خافوا أفقد التركيز على دراستي.
paragraphs.en: My family wasn't initially enthusiastic about the idea, they were afraid I'd lose focus on my studies.

paragraphs.ar: شرحت لهم إني أبغى أسافر وأشتغل شوي عشان أكتشف نفسي أكثر.
paragraphs.en: I explained to them that I wanted to travel and work a bit to discover myself more.

paragraphs.ar: بالنهاية دعموني، والسنة تلك علمتني أشياء ما كانت الجامعة بتعلمني إياها.
paragraphs.en: In the end, they supported me, and that year taught me things university wouldn't have taught me.

questions.question: What did the speaker think about after high school?
How did the family react at first?
What did the speaker explain?
options: Wanting to travel and work to discover themselves

questions.question: What was the result?
options: The family supported them, and they learned valuable things

lessons.title: Inheriting a Business or Starting Your Own
lessons.titleNative: توريث المشروع أو بدء مشروع جديد
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the choice between continuing a family business or forging a new path.

paragraphs.ar: أبوي بنى شركته من الصفر وكان يتمنى أكمل مسيرته فيها.
paragraphs.en: My father built his company from scratch and hoped I would continue his path in it.

paragraphs.ar: بس أنا كان عندي شغف بمجال مختلف تماما، التقنية.
paragraphs.en: But I had a passion for a completely different field, technology.

paragraphs.ar: كانت محادثة صعبة، بس أبوي بالنهاية تفهم اختياري ودعمني.
paragraphs.en: It was a difficult conversation, but in the end my father understood my choice and supported me.

paragraphs.ar: الحين أشتغل بمجالي وهو فخور فيني رغم إني ما كملت مسيرته.
paragraphs.en: Now I work in my field and he's proud of me even though I didn't continue his path.

lessons.title: The Unspoken Rules of Gift-Giving
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the etiquette surrounding gifts.

paragraphs.ar: عندنا عادات معينة بإهداء الهدايا ما تتعلمها إلا بالتجربة.
paragraphs.en: We have certain customs around gift-giving that you only learn through experience.

paragraphs.ar: مثلا، لما تزور بيت حد لأول مرة، من العيب تروح بإيد فاضية.
paragraphs.en: For example, when you visit someone's house for the first time, it's improper to go empty-handed.

paragraphs.ar: وأحيانا الهدية البسيطة والمعنوية تكون أثمن من هدية غالية بدون معنى.
paragraphs.en: And sometimes a simple, thoughtful gift is more valuable than an expensive one without meaning.

paragraphs.ar: تعلمت هالقواعد من أمي، وهي علمتها من جدتي قبلها.
paragraphs.en: I learned these customs from my mother, and she learned them from my grandmother before her.

lessons.title: What the Pearl Divers Taught Us
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the enduring lessons of the pearl-diving era.

paragraphs.ar: قبل النفط، كان الغوص على اللؤلؤ مصدر الرزق الرئيسي لأجدادنا.
paragraphs.en: Before oil, pearl diving was the main source of livelihood for our ancestors.

paragraphs.ar: كانت مهنة خطيرة وصعبة، تحتاج شجاعة وصبر كبير.
paragraphs.en: It was a dangerous and difficult profession, requiring great courage and patience.

paragraphs.ar: لما أسمع قصص الغواصين، أفهم أكثر معنى الصبر والتضحية.
paragraphs.en: When I hear the divers' stories, I understand more deeply the meaning of patience and sacrifice.

paragraphs.ar: هالتاريخ يذكرني إن نجاحنا اليوم مبني على تعب أجيال قبلنا.
paragraphs.en: This history reminds me that our success today is built on the hard work of past generations.

options: The meaning of patience and sacrifice

lessons.title: Technology Changing Daily Life
lessons.context: A reflective passage on the rapid pace of technological adoption.

paragraphs.ar: قبل عشر سنين، كنا نستخدم خرايط ورقية عشان نلقى طريقنا.
paragraphs.en: Ten years ago, we used paper maps to find our way.

paragraphs.ar: اليوم، كل شي من التسوق للطبابة صار ممكن من التلفون.
paragraphs.en: Today, everything from shopping to healthcare has become possible from the phone.

paragraphs.ar: أحيانا أحس إن التغيير سريع جدا وصعب أواكبه بالكامل.
paragraphs.en: Sometimes I feel the change is very fast and hard to fully keep up with.

paragraphs.ar: بس بنفس الوقت، أقدر التسهيلات اللي جابتها هالتقنية لحياتنا.
paragraphs.en: But at the same time, I appreciate the ease this technology has brought to our lives.

lessons.title: What I Want to Pass Down
lessons.context: A reflective closing passage on what matters most to pass on to children.

paragraphs.ar: لما أفكر بمستقبل أولادي، ما يهمني بس الفلوس اللي بخلفها لهم.
paragraphs.en: When I think about my children's future, it's not just the money I'll leave them that matters.

paragraphs.ar: أبغى أعلمهم قيمنا: الكرم والاحترام والفخر بهويتنا.
paragraphs.en: I want to teach them our values: generosity, respect, and pride in our identity.

paragraphs.ar: أبغاهم يعرفون قصة أجدادهم وكيف بنوا هالبلد من الصفر.
paragraphs.en: I want them to know their ancestors' story and how they built this country from nothing.

paragraphs.ar: لأن التراث الحقيقي مو بس أشياء، هو قيم تعيش من جيل لجيل.
paragraphs.en: Because true heritage isn't just things, it's values that live on from generation to generation.
